question:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: All poets are writers. Some writers are thinkers. All thinkers are critics.

Conclusions:

I. Some poets are critics.

II. Some writers are critics.
solution:
Given Statements:

Conclusions:

I. Some poets are critics – False

(Because, no definite relation is given between Poets and Thinkers. The writers who are thinkers may or may not be poets.)

II. Some writers are critics – True

(Because, some writers are thinkers and all thinkers are critics.)

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is Option 1.
